info.title: Bookare API
info.description: Everything Bookare does, without the Bookare screens: run a venue from your own systems (admin), or build your own booking site or app on top of it (public and customer). Each venue has its own address: https://<venue>.bookare.app/api/v1 (or its own domain). All answers are JSON {"data": …}; errors are {"error": {"code", "message", "field"?}}. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and times HH:MM in the venue’s time zone (Europe/Athens); timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC; money is in euro. Send Accept-Language or ?lang=el|en for texts in a language. Full guide: docs/API.md.
